title: THE WELCOME PACK FITS ITS CARD
why: The critic on the centred welcome pack: the intro paragraph spilled out of the card and was struck through by its top edge, and the footer floated below the card. The intro cap was beaten by a later rule and the rows were 80px, so the content was taller than the frame. The intro is capped at 880 and the rows are 64px.
now: The welcome pack title, list and buttons sit inside the card.
